submission.justification:
Mixture-G1 at a 2.5 mm gap gave the best simulated time resolution of all tested points (0.895 ns). Across the gap scan, G1 outperformed G2 (about 1.97-2.32 ns) and G3 (about 1.27-1.53 ns) at every gap. The 2.5 mm gap is the best of the tested G1 points, with 2.25 mm at 0.93 ns and 2.75 mm at 0.942 ns. The gap is inside the 1-3 mm range.

Caveat: the hard GWP100 <= 150 constraint is NOT verified for any candidate. The run recorded gwp100_values_found = 0 and gwp100_verified_candidates = 0, so no GWP values were extracted from candidate_specs.md. I cannot confirm that G1 complies. G1 must not be adopted until its GWP100 is checked against candidate_specs.md. If G1 exceeds 150, the next-best option is G3 at about 2.0 mm (1.273 ns), which also has an unverified GWP100. G2 is the weakest performer and is not recommended on resolution grounds.

G1 at 2.5 mm gives 0.895 ns, the best of all tested points. The optimum was searched only on the tested grid (1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.25, 2.5, 2.75, 3.0 mm), so this is the best tested rather than a proven global optimum.
